objective: Complete a comma-separated label parser with quoted commas, preserved quoted content, trimmed unquoted values, doubled-quote escaping, and meaningful empty fields.
completed: Codex added quoted-comma parsing and a focused test.
Codex reported direct checks for empty fields, empty input, empty quoted input, and non-string input.
decisions: A comma inside a quoted label is data, not a delimiter.
Quoted whitespace is preserved; unquoted surrounding whitespace is trimmed.
Empty fields are meaningful and must not be filtered out.
blockers: Doubled quotes inside quoted fields are not yet decoded as one literal quote.
next: Implement doubled-quote escaping with a focused regression test; preserve quoted commas and empty fields.
